text:
ari: Lab slots for the joint perf bench with CaliberEdge — need to lock a 3-day window next week. Options: Tue-Thu or Wed-Fri. @kevin any constraints? @maria are the CaliberEdge folks arriving on-site? :calendar:
kevin: Tue-Thu works for me but I need to land the kernel patch (patch_v2) by Mon EOD. Also we need lab access 08:00-18:00 for all three days.
maria: CaliberEdge engineers are only available Wed morning on-site. Wed-Fri would be far easier. Also please avoid long reboot chains between runs — they skew watt measurements.
sanjay: Scope suggestion: perf/W sweep (4 power bins), throughput at 1k/5k/10k tokens, and kernel variants: stock, redwood-opt, partner-opt. Keep sample count consistent (N=5).
olivia: Telemetry plan: per-run logs, power.csv, hwmon snapshots, and nvidia-smi dumps. I'll create a transient bucket: s3://redwood-partner-bench/cb-6401/ and a run checklist.
bench-bot: CALENDAR: Tentative booking created for lab-3 / benchroom-2 Tue-Thu 08:00-18:00 (provisional) — please confirm within 24h.
ari: bench-bot shows a tentative block. Maria — can you confirm CaliberEdge on-site availability? If they can only do Wed, we can run Tue-Thu with their on-site presence Wed and remote support other days.
maria: Wed-Fri preferred. CaliberEdge can extend to Fri afternoon if needed. Also FYI legal asked for an NDA addendum for raw logs — partner requested raw logs, but we must keep embargo until signoff.
kevin: Important: do NOT run the patched kernel without a dry-run. Patch v2 changes kernel launch params. Example commands (dry first):
```
./run_bench.sh --config configs/caliber_edge.yaml --kernel patch_v2 --dry-run
```
After verifying, run: `./run_bench.sh --config configs/caliber_edge.yaml --kernel patch_v2 --samples 5 --seq 2048 --outdir /tmp/run`
sanjay: Standardize metrics and headers so ingestion is automated. Proposed CSV header: run_id,model,kernel_variant,batch_size,seq_len,tokens_per_sec,avg_watts,energy_per_token,p95_latency. I'll attach schema to the bucket.
olivia: Will upload the CSV schema and a short logging README to s3://redwood-partner-bench/cb-6401/schema.csv and s3://redwood-partner-bench/cb-6401/README.md by Tue AM. Also will add automated validation that rejects runs missing avg_watts or tokens_per_sec. Alert threshold: avg_watts > 350 triggers ops alert.
ari: Proposed embargo timeline: internal review until 2026-06-10, partner signoff by 2026-06-12, public announce 2026-06-17. Does that work for everyone?
maria: Timeline ok. Partner comms needs final wording by 2026-06-12. Marketplace listing must be coordinated so we don't publish results before the listing is ready.
kevin: One more run-time tip: collect kernel symbols for perf traces. Example: 
```
export KSYM_PATH=/srv/kernels/caliber/patch_v2
sudo perf record -a -g -- ./run_bench.sh --config configs/caliber_edge.yaml --kernel patch_v2 --samples 5
```
Bring the symbol tarball so we can triangulate hotspots quickly.
bench-bot: SAFETY: Fire suppression compliance test is pending for lab-3. Access may be blocked until facilities confirm.
sanjay: I'll coordinate with facilities. If the fire-safety window can't be met, fallback option is to run on dedicated cloud infra and mirror the HW profile (cost add-on). Pros: no lab constraints. Cons: possible minor variance in perf/W.
ari: Ok, consensus leaning to Wed-Fri. Final action items: kevin — PR for patch_v2 by Mon; maria — confirm on-site by EOD; olivia — create bucket and upload schema by Tue AM; sanjay — schedule facilities safety test. I'll send a Wed 07:30 walkthrough invite (walk the rig + runbooks).
kevin: :ok_hand: Working on the PR now, will tag reviewers.
maria: Confirmed on-site Wed-Fri. Partner notified.
olivia: Bucket created: s3://redwood-partner-bench/cb-6401/ — schema uploaded and README in place.
bench-bot: THREAD NOTE: Safety checklist still incomplete. Facilities test scheduled pending.
ari: Thanks everyone — I'll finalize the booking for Wed-Fri and post the embargo calendar invite.
maria: ack
kevin: ack
